name: new-game
expect: Nine empty cells, X to move; local page and assets load.

name: alternate-turns
expect: X at 1, O at 4, X next.

name: occupied-cell
expect: Second move is rejected/disabled without advancing the turn.

name: x-win
expect: X wins; remaining cells cannot change the completed board.

name: reset
expect: Reset clears marks/outcome and restores X.

name: mobile
expect: Board/status/reset controls remain usable in a narrow viewport.
